rows.normalising_statement::eng: All adults use certain methods to teach children the right behaviour or to stop them from behaving badly.
rows.question::eng: How often do you physically discipline your children when they have done something wrong by hitting, spanking, pinching, or slapping with your hand or an object like a stick or a belt?

rows.normalising_statement::eng: Sometimes our children make us really angry or upset, and we do things we wish we hadn't.
rows.question::eng: How often do you shout, yell, or scream at your children when you are angry with them?

rows.normalising_statement::eng: We can experience many different emotions as part of daily life.
rows.question::eng: How often are you bothered by feeling down, sad, depressed, or hopeless?

rows.normalising_statement::eng: Daily life can bring up a lot of worries and feelings.
rows.question::eng: How often have you not been able to stop or control worrying?

rows.normalising_statement::eng: Every child has days when it is hard for them to listen and follow rules
rows.question::eng: How often does your child not obey you, or is it difficult to make them obey you?

rows.normalising_statement::eng: It is normal for our children to feel bad or behave badly sometimes.
rows.question::eng: Thinking about the child who has been having the most difficulties, how often does your child feel sad or empty?
